memo: New component on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits. Our stack: fragment re-rank on molecules neither GLACIER nor ICEBERG scored + neutral-loss evidence (e3fg05nl05c-1 0.434). New part: a decoy correction of our fragment score. A candidate whose 1-2 bond cuts give more distinct fragment masses explains more peaks by chance; the score becomes the explained share minus its mean over the same spectra shifted by -9/-5/-3/+3/+5/+9 Da (the chance rate for that candidate). Train check (enveda-np-examples, 171 molecules, truth among 20 same-formula train isomers): raw fragment score alone MRR 0.287 (below random 0.305), corrected 0.304, ratio 0.315. Hypothesis: removing the chance matches makes the blind-molecule re-rank cleaner -> LB > 0.434, toward bronze 0.441.
